# anthropic_workspace_members (Data Source)

Lists the users who are members of an Anthropic workspace through the Admin API. Service account memberships are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspace_members" "production" {
  workspace_id = anthropic_workspace.production.id
}

output "production_admins" {
  value = [
    for member in data.anthropic_workspace_members.production.members :
    member.user_id
    if member.workspace_role == "workspace_admin"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace ID.
- `members` (Attributes List) The workspace's members, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `user_id` (String) ID of the user.
- `workspace_role` (String) Role of the user in the workspace: `workspace_admin`, `workspace_billing`, `workspace_developer`, `workspace_restricted_developer`, or `workspace_user`.
